responsibility: Provides manual structural formatting impls for trait-resolution data types whose debug output is needed by the compiler, specifically the `Debug` representations for `ImplSource` and `ImplSourceUserDefinedData`.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `ty/structural_impls.rs`, which supplies a broad set of manual `Debug`, `Lift`, `TypeFoldable`, and `TypeVisitable` impls for many `ty`-related types, this file is narrowly limited to manual `Debug` formatting for a small set of trait-resolution types (`ImplSource` and related data).
